body:
Dear Val,
The regulation of transcription term is coming from the other members of this entry, such as Zinc finger protein GLI2, GLIS3, or ZIC. I will remove this term from the entry so it's not transferred to the S. pombe member. Hope this helps.

Best wishes,
Sara
